enchantment.redomesticate.amphibious.des: Pet cannot dry out or drown on land or in water, increases speed in water, pet will not float but swim quickly
enchantment.redomesticate.blazing_protec: Pet will be protected from damage by 2 blazing bars per level, which knockback and set attackers on fire.
enchantment.redomesticate.blight_curse.d: Plants will wither and die around the pet.
enchantment.redomesticate.bubbling.desc: Pet attacks trap mob inside giant bubble that floats upwards
enchantment.redomesticate.chain_lightnin: Summons a lightning bolt that chains from and damages mobs each time a pet attacks, level increases how many mobs can be hit by lightning
enchantment.redomesticate.chaos.desc: When attacked, pets inflict Chaos on the attacker, forcing them to attack other monsters within 10 blocks
enchantment.redomesticate.charisma.desc: Pet lowers trade prices for its owner, level increases the bargain
enchantment.redomesticate.deflection.des: Pet is protected by a ghostly shield which deflects projectile attacks
enchantment.redomesticate.defusal.desc: Pet can nullify explosion damage to terrain and other mobs, level increases range
enchantment.redomesticate.disc_jockey.de: Pet is followed by a floating jukebox that can play music discs
enchantment.redomesticate.fireproof.desc: Grants pet immunity to fire and lava damage
enchantment.redomesticate.frost_fang.des: Pet attacks now slows mobs shortly and deals freezing damage
enchantment.redomesticate.gluttonous.des: Pet can eat any food item, regardless of dietary restrictions
enchantment.redomesticate.healing_aura.d: Pet will ocassionally heal owner and other pets around it, level determines strength of healing effect.
enchantment.redomesticate.health_boost.d: Increases pet's max health by 10 for each level
Any damage done to pet is transferred to its owner
enchantment.redomesticate.herding.desc: Pet can be followed by wild animals, level increases maximum amount of followers
enchantment.redomesticate.immaturity_cur: Pet appears and behaves as a baby version of itself, with reduced attack damage.
enchantment.redomesticate.immunity_frame: Each level makes pet immune for an additional second after attack
enchantment.redomesticate.infamy_curse.d: Pet can naturally make any nearby monster hostile to it
enchantment.redomesticate.insight.desc: In dark areas, pets highlight surrounding hostile mobs
enchantment.redomesticate.intimidation.d: Pet can scare away hostile mobs with its fearsome appearance, level determines range and frequency of effect
enchantment.redomesticate.linked_invento: Pet can pick up items and teleport them to owner's inventory
enchantment.redomesticate.magnetic.desc: Pet aided by ghostly magnet that pulls targeted mobs towards it
enchantment.redomesticate.muffled.desc: Pet will be silent and not emit vibrations when moving.
enchantment.redomesticate.night_vision.d: Grants Night Vision effect when a pet is nearby
enchantment.redomesticate.ore_scenting.d: Pet can sniff out ore blocks and alert its owner, level determines distance, amount and frequency of ore detection
enchantment.redomesticate.paralysis.desc: When attacked, pets paralyze the attacker for several seconds, preventing movement, jumping or attacking
enchantment.redomesticate.poison_resista: Grants pet immunity to poison effect
enchantment.redomesticate.psychic_wall.d: Pet summons a wall of psychic energy during combat to provide cover, level determines size of wall and length of the effect
enchantment.redomesticate.rejuvenation.d: When injured, pet may absorb experience orbs to heal itself.
enchantment.redomesticate.shadow_hands.d: Pet uses dark magic to attack targets with shadowy hands, level increases speed and amount of hands
enchantment.redomesticate.share.desc: When the pet is attacked, it shares damage with nearby hostile mobs
enchantment.redomesticate.tethered_telep: Pet will teleport with its owner, even across dimensions.
enchantment.redomesticate.total_recall.d: When below 2 health, pet enters a recall orb and is protected until released by its owner
enchantment.redomesticate.tough.desc: Increase pet defense and knockback resistance
enchantment.redomesticate.undead_curse.d: Pet returns as a hostile, zombie pet after death
enchantment.redomesticate.vampire.desc: Pet heals amount of damage done, level increases percentage of dealt damage healed
enchantment.redomesticate.violent.desc: monster will have some debuff when attacked by pet
enchantment.redomesticate.void_cloud.des: Pet is protected from falling off cliffs or into void by a large cloud that lifts it up and returns it to its owner
enchantment.redomesticate.warping_bite.d: Pet will randomly teleport targeted mobs away from it
enchantment.redomesticate.xp_transfer.de: Pets collect and transfer XP to owner
item.redomesticate.deed_of_ownership.des: right click your pet, you can release it
message.redomesticate.wayward_lantern_re: %s has found its way to a nearby Wayward Lantern
notif.friendlyfire.protected: The %s is protected. Crouch to bypass.
